subject: SDLC: CI/CD secrets walkthrough & delivery timeline for assessor
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@bluepeak.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: BluePeak Security Team <audit@bluepeak.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Sep 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: overview + examples of CI/CD secrets handling

Hi Irene,

Thanks for agreeing to support BluePeak's SIG review. To complete our assessment we need two things from Redwood: (1) a short live walkthrough of how CI/CD secrets are provisioned and rotated for hosted builds, and (2) a bundle of representative artefacts (access matrix, rotation proof, and a sample PR gating checklist).

Can you confirm whether the walkthrough can be scheduled next week (Tue/Wed preferred) and what artefacts you can share proactively? Sensitive material can be shared by secure link — we have an NDA in place.

Deliverables we expect (high level):
- CI runner credentials lifecycle (issuance, rotation, revocation)
- PR gating & merge approval evidence for 2 recent releases
- Briefs on ephemeral secrets or vault integration used by CI

Emily Park
Security Assessor, BluePeak Financial
emily.park@bluepeak.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: overview + examples of CI/CD secrets handling

Hi Emily — thanks, and we can absolutely do this. Looping in Soojin (Security) and Marissa (Eng lead for CI) to coordinate artefacts and timing.

Proposed timeline:
- Artefact bundle (secure drive link) delivered by EOD Wed 2025-09-24
- 30–45 minute live walkthrough: Thu 2025-09-25 09:00–09:45 PT or Thu 14:00–14:45 PT (pick one)

Soojin/Marissa — can you confirm we can provide the access matrix, rotation logs, and two PR gating examples in the bundle? Also flag any redactions we should apply (e.g., specific credential IDs).

Irene Choi
Senior Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: overview + examples of CI/CD secrets handling

Thanks Irene — quick internal note on what we'll include and how we'll present it: 

Planned artefacts for bundle (we will attach PDF/CSV/MD stubs):
- ci-access-matrix.csv — mapping of CI runner identities to vault roles (redacted for PII)
- ci-runner-rotation.pdf — rotation schedule exports and audit log snippets for the last 90 days
- pr-gating-checklist.md — checklist used by the release engineers for merge gating

Redaction plan: replace exact runner IDs and token suffixes with placeholders; we will preserve timestamps and the sequence of rotation events for provenance.

Walkthrough agenda (30–45m):
1) High-level architecture (3–5m) — vault + ephemeral agent model
2) Issuance & ephemeral tokens (10–12m) — demo flow for a GitHub Actions runner acquiring secrets via short-lived certs
3) Rotation & revocation (8–10m) — audit examples and automatic rotation policy triggers
4) PR gating tie-in (7–10m) — how we enforce checks before merge and evidence we keep
5) Q&A and follow-ups (5–10m)

Marissa: can you prepare the rotation export (CSV) and point me to the internal runbook link so I can clip examples? I'll prepare the redacted snippets and a drive folder.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Security Engineering, Redwood Inference
